subcommands.description: Invokes the specified Amazon Bedrock model to run inference using the prompt and inference parameters provided in the request body.

options.description: The prompt and inference parameters in the format specified in the contentType in the header. You must provide the body in JSON format.

options.description: The desired MIME type of the inference body in the response. The default value is application/json
